turns.text: You people are thieves and liars. I will come to the studio and smash the frames if you ignore me.

I’m sorry this has been frustrating. I’ve passed your complaint to a colleague who will take over here. Please don’t come to the studio to damage anything. You can tell us what happened in this chat so my colleague can look into it.
